'''Lowick''' was a neutral [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] with equatorial rainforests that was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowick]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who hunted, fished, and farmed in the [[Salt/Legends|salt]] marshes. The planet abounded in [[Fish/Legends|fish]], reptiles, [[marlello]] ducks, and [[veejy fruit]].

==History==
The planet was discovered by [[firegem]] [[Mining/Legends|miners]] who were exploiting the neighboring [[Lowick asteroid belt]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> The Pa'lowick became a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] community, but did not join the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], although they were taken over by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. They did not join the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. When the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaded the planet, they destroyed the planet's mechanical harvesting machines, but not the veejy crops themselves. As a result, the Pa'lowick were able to rebuild their economy after their planet was liberated. They remained unaligned politically.
